illustration.$description: Color slots used by every Connex illustration. Defaults shown here resolve to the Connex brand palette; per-brand JSON files in `src/brand/*.json` override these slots so flipping `data-brand` re-tints every illustration on screen.

primary.$description: Main brand color in the illustration (figure outline, primary stroke).

accent.$description: Soft brand-tinted highlight (gradient stops, subtle fills).

surface.$description: Background surface for the illustration scene.
